dashboard.subtitle: The state of your home lab at a glance
dashboard.noIntegrationsHint: Once data sources such as Healthchecks.io or Immich are set up, the overall status appears here.
dashboard.loadError: Could not load the overall status: {{error}}

backups.subtitle: Last runs, results and overdue backups
backups.empty: Backups from Healthchecks.io (checks with the backup tag) appear here, and later also from Proxmox Backup Server and your own sources.
backups.maxAgeHint: If the last run of "{{name}}" is older, the backup is overdue – from {{percent}} % of it, it is due soon.
backups.stale: At least one source is currently unreachable – showing the data from the last successful poll.
backups.howItWorks: A backup is overdue when its last run is older than the maximum age (default {{age}}, marked with *), and due soon from {{percent}} % of it. Failed means: the source reports an error. Healthchecks checks with the backup tag appear here automatically.

checks.subtitle: Healthchecks.io checks with uptime history
checks.empty: The checks of your Healthchecks.io projects appear here once an integration is set up.
checks.stale: Unreachable – data from the last poll
checks.howItWorks: One integration per Healthchecks project. The history comes from the status changes in Healthchecks.io (up to 30 days) and is refreshed every 10 minutes and on every status change. Yellow: grace period – the ping is late, but the check is not down yet.

services.subtitle: Metrics and charts per integration
services.empty: Each integration gets a card with its metrics here, e.g. photos, videos and storage in Immich.
services.staleSince: values from the last successful poll {{time}}
services.chartTooFew: Not enough values for a chart yet – it fills up with every poll.

history.subtitle: Status changes and errors of all integrations
history.empty: Status changes and errors appear here once integrations deliver data.

settings.subtitle: Integrations, backups, display and system
settings.generalHint: Changes take effect immediately, without a restart.
settings.timezoneHint: Used for all dates and times in the interface.
settings.rawRetentionHint: Every single poll of the integrations – the basis for uptime and history.
settings.dailyRetentionHint: One value per day and metric – for long-term charts.
settings.backupsHint: When a backup counts as overdue. You can set a different value per backup on the Backups page.
settings.backupMaxAgeHint: Without a new run, a backup is overdue after this time, and due soon from 80 % of it.
settings.backupTagHint: Checks with this tag appear on the Backups page. The tag is set per integration (Integrations → Edit).

system.title: System
system.hint: Keys and credentials are never shown, only whether they are set.
system.secretKeyMissingHint: Without a key, no credentials for integrations can be stored. Create one with: openssl rand -base64 32

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.subtitle: Data sources such as Healthchecks.io. Credentials are stored encrypted and never shown.
integrations.chooseType: Which data source would you like to connect?
integrations.noSecretKey: LABDECK_SECRET_KEY is not set – credentials can only be entered as a reference such as {{example}} to an environment variable.
integrations.name: Name
integrations.nameHint: Shown on the dashboard, e.g. "Healthchecks home lab".
integrations.secretHint: Instead of the value, you can also use a reference such as {{example}} to an environment variable with the prefix SECRET_.
integrations.intervalHint: How often labdeck queries the source.
integrations.tlsVerifyHint: Turn off for self-signed certificates in your LAN.
integrations.deleteHint: "{{name}}" will be deleted including its history and metrics.

uptime.title: Uptime {{range}}
uptime.gaps: Gaps in this period (grey): no history known
